comments.text: Prepares animation anim_number of fighter X: clears anim_finished, dx and dy, sets the delay to 1 and anim_started. The length is the low byte of the next script pointer minus this one. Callers: anim_update and the move state machine $23e0.
-4: the first step adds 4 and gives step 0
Reverse: the first step subtracts 4 and gives the last step
